text: Fixed and shipped, nothing broken. v1.0.3 adds the Live light middle tier: when the model is 80-89% sure and the edge is at least 5% after the fee, it bets real money at 10 cents a bet. The older strict rules and their stakes are unchanged, and 75-79% stays recorded only. The whole test floor passes, including a new test for the 10-cent stake and the 80%/5% floors. (One timing test failed once under load and passed on re-run.) The earlier half-saved edit is now consistent. SX/Polymarket: names match; props are missing on SX, so those bets can't show SX. Download: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.3
